decls.name: IdealClassPigeonholeFiber

paper_span.quote: These $2^m$ ideals need not be principal, but they occupy only $h(K)$ ideal classes. Thus some

decls.rationale: The class-group pigeonhole opening the proof of Proposition 2.2, in abstract form: for any \(\Phi : D \to C\) between nonempty finite types some fibre has size \(\ge |D|/|C|\) — here \(\varepsilon \mapsto [A_\varepsilon]\), giving a fibre of size \(\ge 2^m/h(K)\).
